video_title: John Wall on becoming Wizards GOAT, BEST high school hoop mixtape | Jeff Teague x Club 520

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on his early years and culture change in Washington
quotes.excerpt: coming here as a 19-year-old kid, no facial hair, no kids, no tattoo, they embraced me.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: Coming here as a 19-year-old kid, no facial hair, no kids, no tattoo, they embraced me. They acted like I was from here. So, Washington was great to be here and through the tough times of not winning games early on, to figuring out and learn how to win and change the culture, this will always be my second home.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: He is good at this, isn't he? He did that, he is the president, you know, vibes.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on the impact of NIL on young players
quotes.excerpt: don't let it change you. Some of these kids are getting the money and they're not working out.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: The most important thing I tell the kids with NIL is don't let it change you. Some of these kids are getting the money and they're not working out the same way they was before because you can tell if they really love the game or they want the lifestyle. I got the cars, I got the jewelry, I got the clothes, I'm not working out the same way. So, I think me, if I was in college, I probably would have got, if they say Cooper Flagg got 20, I would have got 30. Because I had a dance and I had a song, so you got to add that into it.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: Cooper Flagg got 20 million? They say all together like with new balance and all the stuff he got, he got 20.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall ranks his high school mixtape era
quotes.excerpt: I go Kyrie Irving two, Austin Rivers three, and then I go myself four.
quotes.quote: I go Kyrie Irving two, Austin Rivers three, and then I go myself four. I'm number one, I'm number one. I go Kyrie Irving two, Austin Rivers three, and then I go myself four.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on his decision to attend Kentucky
quotes.excerpt: I remember my first time watching DeMarcus Cousins play Oklahoma in the garden. I see how he played.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: Whatever coach Cal was going, that's where I was going. I remember my first time watching DeMarcus Cousins play Oklahoma in the garden. I see how he played, I was like that's exactly the way I play, so why would I go anywhere else? Me, I just wanted to take all the visits, get all the free gear. I got that did that and DeMarcus Cousins, Eric Bledsoe, Daniel Orton, Darnell Dodson, all them came on their own. And I remember getting that coach Cal was like, I know you leaving at eight months, but don't leave by yourself. I'm like what you mean? He like take some people with you. I didn't think I was going to take four guys in the first round, but we ended up being the first group of guys to have five guys go in the first round.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: Did you bring the guys on DeMarcus Cousins, Bledsoe?

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on his experience at Kentucky
quotes.excerpt: I watched you a lot at Wake Forest. I even came down there I think the year you had just left.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: I watched you a lot at Wake Forest. I even came down there I think the year you had just left. I came down there and Ish Smith was down there, CJ Harris, Al-Farouq Aminu, all them went there, because I was thinking about you was coming back that next year. And we would have played them, we would have played y'all, remember we played y'all in the tournament when you was gone.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: You were thinking about coming back that next year?

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on his first meeting with Jeff Teague
quotes.excerpt: It was my first time meeting, bro. I said he a cool ass dude, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: It was my first time meeting, bro. I said he a cool ass dude, bro. You came to my city and got to it, man, in the lockout. And what you probably didn't know about this, Teague was a little motivated because of B-H, it had nothing to do with you, because of Shell. Shout out to Shell and Mac.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on being drafted to Washington
quotes.excerpt: It was surreal. I think just, you know, everybody dream of making it to the league.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: It was surreal. I think just, you know, everybody dream of making it to the league, but we don't know where we going to get drafted. But my dad was from Southeast DC, like a lot of people didn't know that, so being able to drive four hours from North Carolina, my family could make it to every game. But like I said earlier, just embracing me, knowing that I was trying to figure it out with everything that just went on with the organization, handing me the keys, understood that it was a slow process.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: I want to talk about when getting drafted here and being a number one pick going to DC.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on playing through a broken hand in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: You got hurt. We played y'all in the playoffs. Remember you was mad at me.

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: You got hurt. We played y'all in the playoffs. Remember you was mad at me. You hurt your hand, I think you might have broke your hand. I remember I was like, damn, John Hurt. I didn't say damn, I was like, yeah, John Hurt.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: But we had a battle. I remember I want to talk to you about this. We ain't had a pod yet. I want to talk to you. You got hurt. We played y'all in the playoffs. Remember you was mad at me.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on the Philadelphia 76ers' current roster
quotes.excerpt: Did we ever see the Philadelphia 76ers looking that the way that they look at right now?

text_blocks.speaker: John Wall
text_blocks.text: Did we ever see the Philadelphia 76ers looking that the way that they look at right now? Like, we thought Jaylen Brown was a crazy pickup in the offseason. Then niggas get Bron too. Like, the East looking crazy. I know the Wizards on the rise, but it's going to be interesting. It's going to be interesting.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: Why we on some hoop shit?
